items.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
items.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

items.title: What Democrats can and can't do with their new power after taking Congress
items.description: Democrats can vote legislation through. But Trump still has veto power.

items.title: France holds new strikes and protests as unions demand immediate answers
items.description: Five of France's unions join a wave of strikes and protests in a national day of action.

items.title: A bitter end for Ronaldo - the icon who transformed Portugal
items.description: As Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football, Guillem Balague looks at why and what is next for the Portugal legend.

items.title: Joshua Wong, face of Hong Kong's pro-democracy protests, jailed for 10 years
items.description: Wong, 30, is among hundreds of Hongkongers detained under the controversial national security law.

items.title: Typhoons batter East Asia as El Niño makes Pacific 'burn with fever'
items.description: Even for countries where typhoons are a way of life, the last few months have brought unusually wild weather.

items.title: Pope Leo hosts Bob Dylan at official residence in Rome
items.description: Pope Leo had previously quoted Dylan's work in the preface of a book warning against nuclear rearmament.

items.title: India's costliest film retells a beloved Hindu epic - but divides critics
items.description: Easily the most anticipated Bollywood film of the year, Ramayana: Rise of a Legend is the first of two parts.

items.title: Mother and daughter die after suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada
items.description: Authorities in British Columbia say evidence suggests an animal may have been involved in the women's deaths.

items.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
items.description: At least 40 people were killed and another 30 may still be under the rubble after Monday's attack on a Ukrainian village, Kyiv says.

items.title: Watch: How rapist Brand was never far from controversy
items.description: BBC correspondent Sima Kotecha explains how the trial unfolded.

items.title: Was an Italian chef really fired over refusal to put pineapple on pizza?
items.description: The chef had stated that putting pineapple on pizza was "offensive to his culture".

claude-code.name: amux
claude-code.description: The agent control plane: run Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI agents in parallel with a shared task board, schedules and usage-limit recovery. Native iPhone, iPad and Mac apps plus a web dashboard. Self-host (Rust + SQLite, Tailscale remote access) or use amux Cloud. MIT + Commons Clause.

claude-code.name: bifrost
claude-code.description: Open-source, high-performance AI gateway that works as your LLM gateway, MCP gateway and agent gateway. One OpenAI-compatible API for 10,000+ models, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys, budgets and MCP Code Mode. Works with any SDK or agent and adds under 200µs of overhead at 5k RPS.
